card.name: Two-party interactions and co-administration
card.fires_on: Words in text about two parties acting together, such as two drugs given together or two countries trading. It fires on linking words like on, and, apart, is, use after the pair is named.

modes.label: Drug pairs given together
modes.description: Linking word after two named drugs or after concomitant or co-administration wording.

modes.label: Spacing between two drugs
modes.description: Words about timing of one drug relative to another on the same day or hours apart.
modes.example: Administer KEYTRUDA QLEX prior to cisplatin when given<< on>> the same day.

modes.label: Bilateral relations
modes.description: Trade or relations between two countries.

card.writes: It pushes words meaning both sides or mutual, such as 双方, mutual and お互い.
